title: Titles returned by /api/shared are inserted as raw HTML
evidence: app.js:44-46: the JSON from the server is mapped into a template string and passed to insertAdjacentHTML. These titles belong to other users' shared notes, so this is a cross-user sink and not only self-XSS.
failing_case: Another user shares a note titled . Anyone who types a matching search runs the script and sends all their notes away.
remediation: Create li elements and set textContent. Validate the response shape (array of objects with a string title) before using it.

title: Notes cannot be opened or deleted by keyboard or screen reader
evidence: Rows are <li> with a click handler (app.js:30-33) and the delete control is a <div> with onclick. Driven: Tab order is search, new, title, body and then leaves the page; no row or delete control is reachable. No role, tabindex, name or key handler. WCAG 2.1.1 (A), 4.1.2 (A).
failing_case: A keyboard-only or screen-reader user can create a note but cannot open an existing one or delete any note.
remediation: Render each row as a <button> (or a link) for opening and a separate <button aria-label="Delete note: TITLE"> for deleting, inside a labelled list.

title: Clicking a shared search result throws
evidence: Driven: shared <li class="shared"> has no data-id, so Number(undefined) is NaN, notes.find returns undefined and openNote throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading title)'. Shared items look clickable (the list shows a pointer cursor via #list li).
failing_case: Search, click a shared result: console error, nothing happens, no feedback.
remediation: Ignore list items without a data-id, or give shared items an explicit action; make openNote tolerate a missing note.

title: Shared-note results are appended without checking they match the current query, and pile up
evidence: Each input event clears the list (renderList, app.js:42) and starts a fetch (app.js:44). Each response appends to whatever is on screen. There is no debounce, abort, request counter or de-duplication. A non-OK response goes to res.json and then only to console.log, so the user is not told the shared search failed. Every keystroke also sends the query to the server.
failing_case: Type 'ab' at normal speed. renderList('a'), fetch(a); renderList('ab') clears; response for 'a' appends its rows, then response for 'ab' appends its rows. The list shows shared notes for both queries. If the 'a' response arrives last, results for the old query stay under 'ab'.
remediation: Debounce the request, use an AbortController (or sequence number) and drop stale responses, render shared results in their own container, and show an error row on failure.

title: Viewport blocks pinch zoom (WCAG 1.4.4)
evidence: maximum-scale=1 in the viewport meta disables user scaling on mobile browsers that honour it.
failing_case: A low-vision user on a phone cannot zoom in to read the 12 px hint or the small rank text.
remediation: Use width=device-width, initial-scale=1 and nothing else.

title: Title and body fields have no label or name; search has only a placeholder
evidence: index.html:13 (placeholder only), :19 and :20 have no label, aria-label or placeholder. Placeholder text is not a reliable accessible name and disappears on input.
failing_case: A screen reader announces 'edit text' and 'edit text multi-line' for the two editor fields, and the user cannot tell which is the title (WCAG 1.3.1, 3.3.2, 4.1.2).
remediation: Add visible <label for> elements (Title, Note) and an aria-label or visible label on the search field.

title: Typing with no note selected (first run, or after deleting the open note) throws and the text is silently lost
evidence: Driven: on empty storage, typing in #title threw 'Cannot set properties of null (setting title)' after 500 ms and nothing was stored. After deleting the open note, the editor still shows the deleted note's text and every further edit throws the same error.
failing_case: A new user opens the page and types a title and body into the editor. Nothing saves, nothing tells them. After a delete the stale text remains visible in the editor.
remediation: Disable or hide the editor until a note is selected; clear it on delete; guard scheduleSave against a null currentNote.

title: Debounced save writes to whatever note is current when the timer fires, so switching notes within 500 ms loses the edit
evidence: scheduleSave (store.js:13-21) reads currentNote and the editor DOM at fire time, not at schedule time. Driven: edited A's title, clicked note B within 500 ms; localStorage afterwards held A unchanged and B with a new `updated` stamp. The edit to A was discarded.
failing_case: Type in note A, click note B within half a second. A's edit is dropped and B is re-stamped as updated, which also reorders its rank.
remediation: Capture the note id and values when scheduling; flush the pending save (or save immediately) before openNote/removeNote changes currentNote; flush on pagehide.

title: persist() swallows quota and storage errors while the UI says changes save automatically
evidence: Driven: with setItem throwing QuotaExceededError, creating and editing a note raised no error and the hint still read 'Changes save automatically'. store.js:26 is an empty catch.
failing_case: Storage full or blocked (private mode): the user keeps writing, sees the reassuring hint, and loses everything on reload.
remediation: Return the result of persist, surface a visible, announced error with the cause and next step, and keep the unsaved state marked as dirty.

title: Fixed 1200 px container scrolls sideways on phones and at 200% zoom
evidence: Driven at 390 px: document scrollWidth was 1222. styles.css:7 adds a fixed 300 px sidebar column with the 400 px-high textarea beside it. No media queries.
failing_case: On a 390 px phone the user must pan horizontally; the editor sits off screen right of the list.
remediation: Use max-width:1200px; width:100%; with padding, and stack .layout to one column under about 700 px.

title: Focus outline is removed with no replacement (WCAG 2.4.7)
evidence: No :focus-visible rule exists anywhere in styles.css. Input borders are #eee in both states (line 13) and the button background does not change.
failing_case: Tabbing through New note, search, title and body shows no indicator at all, so a keyboard user cannot tell where they are.
remediation: Delete the rule, or replace with :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 2px; }.

title: Hint, rank and field border text fail contrast
evidence: Computed: #ccc on #fff is 1.61:1 (styles.css:15); #bbb rank text on the active row #eef is 1.67:1 (styles.css:11, 10); input border #eee on white is 1.16:1 (styles.css:13, WCAG 1.4.11). White on the button #6366f1 is 4.47:1 at 14 px, and white on the hero's #8b5cf6 end is 4.23:1 (WCAG 1.4.3, need 4.5:1).
failing_case: The only status text, 'Changes save automatically', is near-invisible; the input fields have no visible edge.
remediation: Use text at 4.5:1 or better (about #595959 on white), a field border of 3:1 or better, and a darker button/hero colour such as #4f46e5.

quote: const sorted = notes.slice().sort((a, b) => b.updated - a.updated);
title: The full list is copied and sorted again for every visible row
evidence: The sort is inside shown.forEach, so each render is O(n² log n). It runs on every search keystroke and every note open. The rank is also a domain rule computed in the view.
failing_case: With 500 notes, one keystroke performs 500 sorts of 500 items (about 2 million comparisons) plus 500 indexOf scans. At 5,000 notes this freezes typing in the search box.
remediation: Sort once per render (or keep a rank map computed in store.js as a pure function with a test), then look the rank up per row.

title: Notes can be opened only with a mouse: list rows are not focusable or operable by keyboard
evidence: Opening a note is a click listener on the ul (app.js:30-33). The li has no tabindex, no role, no button or link inside, and no key handler. index.html has no other route to a note.
failing_case: Keyboard or screen reader user presses Tab from the search box: focus goes to New note, then straight into the title input. The note list is never reached, so no existing note can be opened (WCAG 2.1.1, level A).
remediation: Render each row as a <button> (or a link) inside the li, with an accessible name from the title, and mark the active one with aria-current.

title: Note titles and shared-note titles are written into innerHTML unescaped (stored XSS)
evidence: app.js:10-11 interpolates n.title into a template assigned via innerHTML; app.js:46 does the same with s.title from /api/shared. Driven: a stored note titled set window.__x on page load; a shared result with the same title also executed.
failing_case: A note titled runs script on every render. The same payload from /api/shared (other users' notes) runs in every searcher's page.
remediation: Build rows with createElement and textContent (or escape at the sink); never concatenate user text into HTML. Validate shared items the same way.

title: Delete is instant, with no confirm or undo, and is invisible yet clickable on touch
evidence: styles.css:12 sets .del to opacity 0 until the row is hovered; it stays clickable. removeNote (app.js:23-28) calls deleteNote and persists straight away. Driven: one click on .del emptied localStorage.
failing_case: On a phone, a tap on the right edge of a row (an invisible target) permanently deletes the note. On desktop, one mis-click does the same.
remediation: Make delete a real <button> with an accessible name, always visible; ask for confirmation or offer a timed undo before persisting.

title: Unguarded JSON.parse at load: corrupt or old-shape storage kills the whole app
evidence: Driven: localStorage 'notes' = '{bad' gave a SyntaxError in store.js, then 'notes is not defined' in app.js; the page is empty and unusable. A record with no `title` would throw in renderList (n.title.toLowerCase()). No version on the saved shape.
failing_case: A truncated write, a manual edit, or a record from an older shape leaves the user with a blank page on every load, with no recovery short of clearing site data.
remediation: Wrap the parse in try/catch, check Array.isArray and normalise each record (id, title, body, updated); keep the bad value under a backup key and tell the user. Add a schema version.

title: No flush on pagehide or visibilitychange: the last 500 ms of typing is lost on close or refresh
evidence: Only the debounce persists edits. grep of the four files finds no pagehide, beforeunload or visibilitychange handler.
failing_case: Type a sentence and press F5 or close the tab within half a second. The sentence is lost, although the hint says changes save automatically.
remediation: Add a pagehide and visibilitychange listener that runs the pending save immediately (a flushSave function shared with the timer).

title: Editing a title never refreshes the list, so the list label and rank are stale
evidence: scheduleSave saves but never calls renderList. Driven: after renaming the open note to 'Renamed' and waiting 700 ms, the list still read 'A #1'.
failing_case: Rename a note: the sidebar keeps the old title and the old rank until a search or click triggers a render.
remediation: Re-render (or update the one row) after the save completes; keep the save logic and the view update behind one function.

quote: const note = { id: Date.now(), title: 'Untitled', body: '', updated: Date.now() };
title: Date.now() ids collide for two creates in the same millisecond
evidence: Driven with a fixed clock: two New note clicks gave ids [1, 5, 5]. deleteNote and openNote match by id.
failing_case: A double-click or script that creates twice in one millisecond gives two notes with one id; opening either opens the first, and deleting either deletes both.
remediation: Use crypto.randomUUID() (or a counter above max existing id) and check for an existing id.

title: Placeholder Latin text is shipped in the page header
evidence: The header paragraph reads 'Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, your notes, supercharged.' It is user-visible, not a comment.
failing_case: Every visitor sees filler text in the first screen.
remediation: Delete the sentence, or replace it with one line saying what the app does.

title: No empty, no-results, loading or error states; saves are not announced
evidence: On first run the list is an empty <ul> and the editor is live but non-functional (see the save finding). Search with no match shows nothing. The hint at index.html:21 is static, has no aria-live, and never reports a failed save.
failing_case: A first-time user sees a hero, an empty box and an editor that discards their typing, with no instruction on what to do.
remediation: Add copy such as 'No notes yet. Select New note to start.', a 'No notes match' row, and an aria-live status that shows Saved at HH:MM or the failure.
